name: Yukina
source:
She is the secondary heroine and daughter of Saeko. She is intelligent and good-looking.

She is bright, kind, cheerful, and loved by everyone at school. In order to save Saeko, she gives herself up to a delinquent and is humiliated. And then, ......?

She is a Virgin and has a chubby belly.

"I will take my mother's place..."
